meta.name: smart-explore
meta.description: Token-optimized structural code search using tree-sitter AST parsing. Use instead of reading full files when you need to understand code structure, find functions, or explore a codebase efficiently.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用AST解析快速搜索代码结构，替代逐文件阅读
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要在不熟悉的代码库中快速找到函数或结构
copy.tagline_en: Search code structure quickly with AST parsing, replacing full file reads
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to quickly find functions or structures in unfamiliar codebases

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 探索代码时优先用 smart_search、smart_outline、smart_unfold 取代 Read/Grep/Glob:先给出文件和符号的结构图,再按需展开某个函数或类的完整源码。
howto.when: 当 Claude 需要理解代码结构、查找函数或探索代码库时接管,改用 smart_* 工具;读小型非代码文件、精确字符串或正则搜索等仍用普通工具。

say.text: 用 smart_search 在 ./src 里搜 shutdown 相关符号
say.note: 返回排名符号和文件折叠视图

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude explores code with smart_search, smart_outline and smart_unfold instead of Read, Grep or Glob: it returns ranked symbols and folded file views first, then unfolds one symbol's full source on demand.
howto.when_en: Triggers when Claude needs to understand code structure, find functions or explore a codebase; it overrides default exploration, while small non-code files and exact string search still use standard tools.

say_en.text: Use smart_search to find shutdown symbols in ./src
say_en.note: Returns ranked symbols and file structure
Lists its functions and class members

say_en.text: Use smart_unfold for the shutdown method in worker-service.ts
